_comment: il_supermarket_scarper DumpFolderNames value (the actual scraper/dumps/<X> folder name on disk) -> Hebrew market_name stored in market_prices.market_name. Keyed by folder name, NOT the ScraperFactory enum name (e.g. RAMI_LEVY the enum vs RamiLevy the folder) -- confirmed by running the scraper and inspecting scraper/dumps/ directly, and by extracting il_supermarket_scarper.utils.DumpFolderNames. Shared by scraper/chain_map.py and scripts/sync_scraped_prices.js so there's one source of truth. Where a chain is already seeded (see CHAIN_STORES in src/app/api/shopping/compare/route.ts), the name matches exactly so new rows land under existing names. Chains not yet in CHAIN_STORES will be skipped by geolocation filtering there until a branch location is added -- a follow-up, not a bug here.
